```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
```

Add layers (i.e. features) to the map by using layer functions:\
`addTiles()`\
`addMarkers()`\
`addCircles()`\
`addPolygons()`\
`addLegend()`\

```{r}
# Basic usage
leaflet()
```

```{r}
leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addMarkers(
    lng = -122.2579, 
    lat = 37.8718)
```

```{r}
leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addMarkers(
    lng = -122.2579, 
    lat = 37.8718, 
    popup = "Fiat Lux")
```

```{r}
leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addMarkers(
    lng = -122.2579, 
    lat = 37.8718, 
    popup = "Fiat Lux") |> 
  setView(
    lng = -122.2579, 
    lat = 37.8718,
    zoom = 18)
```

```{r}
leaflet() |> 
  addProviderTiles(
    "CartoDB.Positron") |> 
  addMarkers(
    lng = -122.2579, 
    lat = 37.8718, 
    popup = "Fiat Lux")
```

```{r}
leaflet() |> 
  addProviderTiles(
    "Esri.WorldImagery") |> 
  addMarkers(
    lng = -122.2579, 
    lat = 37.8718, 
    popup = "Fiat Lux")
```



## Adding Data Objects
```{r}
storms75 <- filter(storms, year == 1975)

storms75
```

```{r}
storms75 |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addCircles(
    lng = ~long, 
    lat = ~lat,
    label = ~name,
    color = ~name)
```

```{r}
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = rainbow(8), 
  domain = storms75$name)

storms75 |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addCircles(
    lng = ~long, 
    lat = ~lat,
    label = ~name,
    color = ~pal(name))
```

```{r}
storms75 |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addCircles(
    lng = ~long, 
    lat = ~lat,
    label = ~name,
    color = ~pal(name)) |> 
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft", 
    pal = pal, 
    values = ~name,
    title = "Storm name")
```

```{r}
storms75 |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addCircles(
    lng = ~long, 
    lat = ~lat,
    label = ~paste0(name, ": ", month, "-", day),
    radius = ~wind*1000,
    weight = 1, 
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = ~pal(name)) |> 
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft", 
    pal = pal, 
    values = ~name)
```

## Polygons
```{r}
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
usa_states = ne_states(
  country = "United States of America", 
  returnclass = "sf")

leaflet(data = usa_states) |> 
  addTiles() |>
  setView(lng = -90, lat = 40, zoom = 3) |>
  addPolygons(fillColor = rainbow(10), stroke = FALSE)
```

```{r}
storms |>
  filter(year == 1975) |>
leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = -50, lat = 30, zoom = 3) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addProviderTiles(provider = "NASAGIBS.ViirsEarthAtNight2012") |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~long, 
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 1, 
    color = "#DDFF03", 
    weight = ~wind/5)
```
